metadata.title: 32-Bit TLS 1.3 / mTLS Enclave Policy & Enforcement Register
metadata.description: Hardware-backed enclave policy control and status register enforcing FIPS 140-3 strict cipher suites, mutual TLS attestation, OCSP stapling, and X.509 chain depth bounds.

fields.name: FIPS_STRICT
fields.description: FIPS 140-3 Level 3 strict cipher enforcement safety interlock. 1 = non-FIPS algorithms rejected at PEP.

fields.name: LEGACY_TLS_ALLOW
fields.description: TLS 1.2 fallback enable. Must remain 0 in ATO zero-trust enclave.

fields.name: KEY_ROTATE_EPOCHS
fields.description: Ephemeral ECDHE key rotation interval override. 0 = default 3600 s cadence.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved per NIST SP 800-52 Rev 2; hardware preserves as zero.

fields.name: CERT_CHAIN_DEPTH
fields.description: Maximum permitted X.509 certificate verification depth (0x3 = 3 intermediate/root hops).

fields.name: OCSP_STAPLE_REQ
fields.description: Mandatory signed OCSP stapling verification during TLS 1.3 handshake.

fields.name: CRL_FAIL_OPEN
fields.description: Revocation timeout fallback mode. 0 = strict fail-closed rejection.

fields.name: SPIFFE_TRUST_DOM
fields.description: Active SPIFFE trust domain binding index (0x1 = prod-enclave-trust).

fields.name: REPLAY_WIN_LOG2
fields.description: 0-RTT early-data replay window log2 size. 0 = 0-RTT disabled.

fields.name: HSM_TAMPER_LATCH
fields.description: HSM cryptographic boundary tamper latch. Write 1 to clear after zeroization audit.

fields.name: MTLS_PEER_ATTEST
fields.description: Hardware-attested mTLS 1.3 peer workload identity verified.
